card: Updates release note snippets to reference their PR numbers and corrects an internal version string. It also updates developer documentation and adds a Rust linter check requiring all release note snippets to contain a PR reference. This prevents snippets from landing without PR attribution and streamlines assembling release notes.
changed_since_previous: No substantial changes to the approach or scope since the previous review.
evidence: PR description: "`32.0` -> `32.1`. Add some missing PR #s (needed if #36769 happens more)."
problem: Release note snippets frequently lack PR numbers or contain outdated version references, complicating final release note compilation. Without automated CI checks, missing PR references are easily overlooked during code review.

risk.why: Only modifies markdown documentation and lint test scripts; a bug would only fail CI or render doc text incorrectly.

scope_notes: Touches 21 release note markdown files alongside a small check added to the Rust test runner linter.
summary: Updates draft release note snippet files to include PR numbers and fix a version number reference. It also updates developer guidelines and extends the doc linter in Rust to require PR number references in all snippet files.
